notes_for_editor: Only one lookout-specific source (Canada Lookouts) and it cites a Manitoba annual report that was not checked directly. Status, access, staffing, agency and height are unknown; nothing found describes the steel tower after 1947 or the site today. The Canada Lookouts listing is a community-run site, so the 1947 date rests on its citation. Record has no local_unit. Two WebSearch calls run; the Bissett historical society and Wikipedia pages were read and had no lookout mention beyond the location. Next step if someone wants more: the 1947-48 Manitoba Department of Mines and Natural Resources annual reports (Archives of Manitoba or HathiTrust) could confirm the replacement and give height or fate.
